_about: Gates for scripts/bench-startup.py --budgets. Time gates are median / floor median (floor = compiled C hello), not absolute ms, so a slower or busier machine scales both sides. Ratio maxima are about 2.5x the measured ratio so they hold under load; tighten them after an optimization lands. Spawn gates are exact counts from the PATH-shim pass and do not depend on load. 'target' is the planned value once further startup work lands; only 'max' is enforced.

ratio_over_floor._baseline: Ratios before the startup work, hermetic, non-git cwd: a_version 1.6, a_help 1.5, b ready 10.3, c request 3.7, c wall 5.0, d response 10.2, d no-key 10.3. After in-process worktree identity and the early ACP initialize: b ready 3.8, b wall 4.2, d response 1.5 (1.4 / 3.0 / 3.4 with every core busy); --git-repo is similar. c and d no-key did not move in this benchmark.
ratio_over_floor._d_acp_session_usable: spawn to the session/new response written right after initialize: the session is usable. d_acp_initialize is only the handshake answered, which graff can send before the session exists. Ratio about 3.6-4.0 after the startup work (pre-series about 10.5).

default._tighten: REPL/ACP boot resolves the worktree identity in-process (git_dirs.zig) and spawns no git. Tighten security on the no-key path once there is a Keychain index.

git_repo._tighten: Same as default: an ordinary one-commit repo is resolved in-process too (GRAFF_AUTO_ISOLATE=off is always set by the benchmark).
